title: SWF: ActionScript Math object methods
description: Verify Math object calls compile correctly: Math.abs(x), Math.floor(x), Math.ceil(x), Math.round(x), Math.sqrt(x), Math.pow(x,y), Math.min(a,b), Math.max(a,b), Math.sin(x), Math.cos(x), Math.PI, Math.random(). These all compile as ActionGetVariable('Math') + ActionGetMember + ActionCall. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/mathmethods.test.ts.
